name: TzHaar

unlocks.name: Hot Stuff
unlocks.notes: Allows Chaeldar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal to assign TzHaar.

variantInfo.name: TzHaar-Hur
notes: Attacking a TzHaar-Hur can cause nearby Mej, Xil, and Ket to become aggressive.
Uses melee and is one of the lower-level city varieties.

variantInfo.name: TzHaar-Mej
notes: Uses magic and melee.
Attacking one near higher-ranked TzHaar can call nearby Xil and Ket to help.

variantInfo.name: TzHaar-Xil
notes: Two variants use melee and one melee/range variant uses a ring or disc.
The melee-using Xil are a recommended city target because they can be safespotted through vents.

variantInfo.name: TzHaar-Ket
notes: Standard TzHaar-Ket in the main Mor Ul Rek city.
Ket are primarily melee and can be safespotted through vents or bursted around TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges.

variantInfo.name: TzHaar-Ket
notes: The level 221 inner-area TzHaar-Ket requires a one-time fire cape show and can drop obsidian armour.
Ket are primarily melee and can be safespotted through vents or bursted around TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges.

variantInfo.name: TzTok-Jad
notes: Can be offered as a TzHaar assignment alternative even before the first Jad kill.
Completing the Fight Cave gives 37,010 total Slayer XP on task.
Task status improves the Jad pet rate by 50%.

variantInfo.name: TzKal-Zuk
notes: Can be offered as a TzHaar assignment alternative only after at least one off-task TzKal-Zuk kill.
Completing the Inferno gives about 125,000 total Slayer XP on task, with 101,890 XP from Zuk.
Combat achievement rewards can increase a Zuk task to two or three kills.

locationComparison.name: Mor Ul Rek (TzHaar City)
notes: Main city TzHaar task area.
TzHaar-Ket and melee-using TzHaar-Xil can be safespotted through vents.
Ring of wealth increases the chance of gems and onyx bolt tips from eligible TzHaar drops.

locationComparison.name: Mor Ul Rek inner TzHaar-Ket
notes: Requires showing a fire cape once to enter the inner area.
Level 221 TzHaar-Ket around TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges can be stacked for burst or barrage tasks.
Protect from Melee avoids all damage in the inner Ket area when Ket heavily outnumber Mej and Xil.

locationComparison.name: TzHaar Fight Cave
notes: TzTok-Jad may be selected instead of regular city TzHaar when the Slayer master offers the Jad alternative.
Leaving or dying in the Fight Cave ends the run, so treat this as a separate boss trip.

locationComparison.name: Inferno
notes: TzKal-Zuk may be selected instead of regular city TzHaar after at least one previous off-task Zuk kill.
Combat achievement rewards can increase the TzKal-Zuk task size.

taskNotes: The Hot Stuff unlock costs 100 slayer points and enables TzHaar assignments from Chaeldar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal.
A Ring of wealth increases chances for gems from TzHaar drops and improves access to onyx bolt tips from the eligible level 221 Ket.
Attacking TzHaar-Hur can make nearby TzHaar aggressive, while attacking TzHaar-Mej can call nearby Xil and Ket.
TzHaar-Ket and melee-using TzHaar-Xil are the preferred city kills because Ket can be safespotted through vents.
Showing a fire cape once unlocks the inner area with level 221 TzHaar-Ket.
The Slayer master may offer TzTok-Jad or TzKal-Zuk instead of a regular city task; Zuk requires a prior off-task Zuk kill.
The TzHaar-Ket-Rak inner-area Ket group supports burst and barrage methods with Protect from Melee.
recommendedMethod: Use melee against Ket or melee-using Xil in Mor Ul Rek, safespot through vents where possible, or choose the Jad/Zuk task alternative when offered and prepared.
